info.title: ProductLift Universal API
info.description: ProductLift is a customer feedback, roadmap, changelog, and product vision platform for collecting ideas, managing posts and comments, organizing categories, tabs, sections, statuses, groups, tags, users, and moderation workflows through a REST API.
